text:
alex: heads up — production batch GPUs started flapping after last deploy, lots of pods CrashLooping with env var errors. looks like secret injection failed during rollout.

maria: seeing same. jobs that mount MODEL_KEYS fail with "env var valueFrom secretKeyRef not found" in pod events. probably injector timing out.

jon: any logs from sops/vault side? i saw some 504s to KMS around 12:05 UTC.

maya: sops-controller logs: "decrypt failed: transient error decrypting key: rpc error: code = Unavailable" then it requeued. multiple secrets not marked ready.

infra-ci-bot: deploy pipeline 2026-03-18T12:04:02Z - helm release "inference-prod" upgrading - step "apply-secrets" timed out (120s)

leo: hypothesis: CI is applying sealed secrets + sops decryption step, but the helm rollout faster than controller can unseal -> pods start before secret objects have data.

maria: that fits. also autoscaler reacted to failed pods by adding more GPU nodes, which then also got pod failures so scale kept oscillating. cost hit is non-trivial (2 extra p4 nodes for ~30m).

alex: urgent workaround: pause rollout and re-create pods after controller catch-up. suggested quickfix:

kubectl rollout pause deploy/inference-worker -n prod
kubectl wait --for=condition=available deploy/inference-worker -n prod --timeout=5m || true
kubectl delete pod -l app=inference-worker -n prod
kubectl rollout resume deploy/inference-worker -n prod

jon: also adding a predeploy job to ensure secrets are present would help. run: 

# in CI
kubectl get secret model-keys -n prod --ignore-not-found || exit 1

maria: i pushed a branch adding a pre-check step + bumping sops-controller retry/backoff and leader-election configs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/432

maya: config diff that helped in my env:

sops-controller:
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
  controller:
    syncInterval: 15s
    retries: 8
    retryBackoff: 4s

le0: small bug: sops->vault agent response had a base64 padding issue for the KMS key annotation. need to ensure CI encodes with openssl base64 -A (no newlines).

sre-oncall: note: set cluster autoscaler scale-down-delay to 15m to avoid churn while we fix. right now it's 2m.

alex: creating a patch in terraform to add this CAAS param. also we should change helm chart to add initContainer that waits for required secrets before starting main container. sample init:

initContainers:
  - name: wait-for-secrets
    image: busybox
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","until kubectl get secret model-keys -n $NAMESPACE; do sleep 2; done"]

jon: init container is good but apps using Helm templating should not rely on kubectl inside pods. better: add post-render hook in CI to fail if secret missing and add lifecycle preStop to tolerate short windows.

maria: i've run the pre-check in canary and it prevented the fail. will merge PR after a second review. also adding a short 10s sleep in helm hooks before launching.

leo: operational follow-up: audit other namespaces for similar patterns (sealed-secrets + fast rolling restarts). i can script a quick grep over repo.

alex: action items:
- merge PR to CI pre-check and sops-controller config (maria)
- terraform change for autoscaler scale-down-delay (alex)
- add initContainer / hook patterns to charts (jon)
- run repo audit for secret injection patterns (leo)
- cost reconciliation for extra GPU nodes this incident (finance+infra)

infra-ci-bot: incident ticket created infra-2026-1123, assign: eng-infra, sre

sre-oncall: scheduled 30m postmortem once incident done. thanks everyone for quick triage :thumbsup:
